Body.Content:
Expense Agent supports more languages and regions, enabling an experience for users in all countries/regions where Business Central is available, and adding the following languages: Czech, Dutch, Finnish, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish.

GA date: October CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
